title: Research
subtitle: observable behavior, accountable interpretation
body: The studies site: public evidence, private controls. Two working instruments, each with its own method. Identity Dissolution is controlled generation under a factorial design — self-reference, repetition and recovery, compared across prompt conditions, with raw turns open to inspection and failed observations kept. Persona Integrity is contextual reading with categorical annotation — marked fiction, unmarked simulation, asserted self-description — recording alternatives and uncertainty instead of collapsing them into a score.

The record comes first: each reviewed release carries its methods, failures and limits, listed in a public JSON index. The site says what it has not done yet, in its own words: a smoke test verifies machinery; it is not a completed research pilot.
note: Smoke-test evidence only so far — no completed pilot yet.
